related.title: Kahn 拓樸排序：建置 DAG 與循環定位
related.titleEn: Kahn topological sorting: build DAGs and cycle detection
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付relax-rounds.csv、循環邊與可達性證據。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver relax-rounds.csv, cycle edges and reachability evidence. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 逐輪列ready queue與各節點indegree；合法序可A B C D或B A C D，不硬訂唯一答案。
related.differenceEn: Trace ready queues and indegrees; either A B C D or B A C D is legal, so do not require one unique order.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
反覆relax可處理負邊；若可從source到達的負循環存在，就不能給受影響節點有限最短路徑。
本課數值核對：4-2+3 = 5 cost；另一項核對：-2+1 = -1 cost。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

入度為零的節點才可從DAG移出；有剩餘節點代表循環或受循環阻擋，不代表剩下全部都在同一cycle。
本課數值核對：max(2,3)+4+1 = 8 s；另一項核對：2+3+4+1 = 10 s。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Repeated relaxation handles negative edges; a reachable negative cycle prevents finite shortest paths for affected vertices.
Numeric audit: 4-2+3 = 5 cost; second audit: -2+1 = -1 cost. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Only zero-indegree nodes can be removed; residual nodes are cyclic or blocked by cycles, not necessarily all members of one cycle.
Numeric audit: max(2,3)+4+1 = 8 s; second audit: 2+3+4+1 = 10 s. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: CSV：引號、換行與欄位契約
related.titleEn: CSV: quoting, newlines and field contracts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付relax-rounds.csv、循環邊與可達性證據。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver relax-rounds.csv, cycle edges and reachability evidence. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 用標準csv writer生成再reader還原，列delimiter、quote與newline策略；所有欄位先保留文字。
related.differenceEn: Round-trip with standard CSV writer/reader, recording delimiter, quote and newline policy while initially preserving strings.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
反覆relax可處理負邊；若可從source到達的負循環存在，就不能給受影響節點有限最短路徑。
本課數值核對：4-2+3 = 5 cost；另一項核對：-2+1 = -1 cost。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

CSV欄位可含逗號與引號，帶引號欄位也可含換行；split逗號或逐行切割都不是完整parser。
本課數值核對：1+1+1 = 3 fields；另一項核對：2-1 = 1 extra_physical_lines。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Repeated relaxation handles negative edges; a reachable negative cycle prevents finite shortest paths for affected vertices.
Numeric audit: 4-2+3 = 5 cost; second audit: -2+1 = -1 cost. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

CSV fields can include commas, quotes and quoted newlines; splitting on commas or physical lines is not a complete parser.
Numeric audit: 1+1+1 = 3 fields; second audit: 2-1 = 1 extra_physical_lines. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
